offering_description.value: The company provides postsecondary career training for students entering transportation, skilled trades, and healthcare occupations. It combines classroom instruction with hands-on training at its campuses and works with manufacturers and employers on specialized technical programs.

primary_services.value: transportation technician training; skilled trades training; manufacturer-specific technician training; allied health and dental training; nursing education

customer_segment.value: B2C: High school graduates, adult career changers, and workers seeking technical or healthcare credentials; B2B: Vehicle manufacturers and employers that sponsor specialized technician training

end_markets.value: automotive and diesel service; healthcare; aviation maintenance; industrial manufacturing and maintenance; building trades

revenue_model.value: service fees: Tuition and program fees for postsecondary career training

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses instructors, labs, and industry equipment to train students and employer-sponsored technicians

geography_served.value: US national: Campuses across the West, Midwest, South, and Northeast

specialization.value: related lines: Transportation technician, skilled trades, and healthcare programs share a campus-based career education model
